--!nonstrict
-- Local presentation only. No match remotes, rewards, teleports or server state.
local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")
local TweenService = game:GetService("TweenService")
local Config = require(game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage").Shared.EndCinematicConfig)
local Controller = { Name = "EndCinematicController", _serial = 0 }

local function make(class, properties, parent)
	local object = Instance.new(class)
	for key, value in pairs(properties) do object[key] = value end
	object.Parent = parent
	return object
end

function Controller:Initialize()
	if self._initialized then return end
	self._initialized = true
	self._serial = 0
end

function Controller:IsPlaying() return self._run ~= nil end

function Controller:_alive(run)
	return self._run == run and run.Id == self._serial
end

function Controller:_tween(run, object, duration, properties)
	if not self:_alive(run) then return false end
	local tween = TweenService:Create(object, TweenInfo.new(math.max(duration, 0.001), Enum.EasingStyle.Sine, Enum.EasingDirection.InOut), properties)
	table.insert(run.Tweens, tween)
	tween:Play()
	local result = tween.Completed:Wait()
	return self:_alive(run) and result == Enum.PlaybackState.Completed
end

function Controller:Stop()
	local run = self._run
	if not run then return end
	self._run = nil
	self._serial += 1
	for _, connection in ipairs(run.Connections) do connection:Disconnect() end
	for _, tween in ipairs(run.Tweens) do tween:Cancel() end
	for _, track in ipairs(run.Tracks) do pcall(function() track:Stop(0); track:Destroy() end) end
	for _, sound in ipairs(run.Sounds) do sound:Stop() end
	for gui, enabled in pairs(run.HiddenHUDs or {}) do if gui.Parent then gui.Enabled = enabled end end
	if run.Camera then
		pcall(function()
			run.Camera.CameraType = run.CameraType
			local subject = run.CameraSubject
			if not subject or not subject.Parent then
				local char = Players.LocalPlayer.Character
				subject = char and char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
			end
			run.Camera.CameraSubject = subject
			run.Camera.CFrame = run.CameraCFrame
			run.Camera.FieldOfView = run.FieldOfView
		end)
	end
	for _, object in ipairs(run.Resources) do object:Destroy() end
end

function Controller:_transition(run)
	local gui = make("ScreenGui", { Name = "EndCinematicTransition", IgnoreGuiInset = true, ResetOnSpawn = false, DisplayOrder = 10000 }, Players.LocalPlayer.PlayerGui)
	table.insert(run.Resources, gui)
	-- Full-height, oversized rotated panels: diagonal inner edges with overlap.
	local panels = {}
	for index, sign in ipairs({ -1, 1 }) do
		local panel = make("Frame", { Name = index == 1 and "Left" or "Right", AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5), Size = UDim2.fromScale(2, 6), Position = UDim2.fromScale(0.5 + sign * 3, 0.5), Rotation = Config.Transition.Angle, BackgroundColor3 = Config.Transition.Color, BorderSizePixel = 0, ZIndex = 10 }, gui)
		table.insert(panels, panel)
	end
	return panels
end

function Controller:_slide(run, panels, closed)
	local duration = closed and Config.Transition.CloseDuration or Config.Transition.OpenDuration
	local tweens = {}
	for index, panel in ipairs(panels) do
		local sign = index == 1 and -1 or 1
		local target = UDim2.fromScale(0.5 + sign * (closed and 0.94 or 3), 0.5)
		local tween = TweenService:Create(panel, TweenInfo.new(duration, Enum.EasingStyle.Quint, Enum.EasingDirection.InOut), { Position = target })
		table.insert(run.Tweens, tween); table.insert(tweens, tween); tween:Play()
	end
	tweens[1].Completed:Wait()
	return self:_alive(run)
end

function Controller:_rig(run, winner, slot, stage, cameraEnd)
	local description
	local player = Players:GetPlayerByUserId(winner.UserId)
	local humanoid = player and player.Character and player.Character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
	if humanoid then description = humanoid:GetAppliedDescription()
	elseif winner.UserId > 0 then description = Players:GetHumanoidDescriptionFromUserIdAsync(winner.UserId)
	else error("No description available for Studio user " .. tostring(winner.UserId)) end
	if not self:_alive(run) then description:Destroy(); return end
	local ok, rig = pcall(function() return Players:CreateHumanoidModelFromDescriptionAsync(description, Enum.HumanoidRigType.R15) end)
	description:Destroy()
	if not ok then error(rig) end
	if not self:_alive(run) then rig:Destroy(); return end
	rig.Name = "Winner_" .. tostring(winner.UserId)
	for _, object in ipairs(rig:GetDescendants()) do
		if object:IsA("LuaSourceContainer") or object:IsA("Tool") then object:Destroy()
		elseif object:IsA("BasePart") then object.CanCollide = false; object.CanTouch = false; object.CanQuery = false end
	end
	local root = assert(rig:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart"), "Rig root missing")
	root.Anchored = true
	rig.Parent = run.Container
	local _, size = rig:GetBoundingBox()
	local rigHumanoid = rig:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
	local bottomOffset = rig:GetPivot().Position.Y - root.Position.Y + rigHumanoid.HipHeight + root.Size.Y / 2
	local finish = slot.CFrame * CFrame.new(0, slot.Size.Y / 2 + bottomOffset, 0)
	-- Walk ends at the authored slot; clamp its starting point to the platform.
	local distance = math.max(0, Config.Winners.WalkDistance)
	local floor = stage.Structure:FindFirstChild("Floor")
	while distance > 0 do
		local start = finish * CFrame.new(0, 0, distance)
		local localPoint = floor.CFrame:PointToObjectSpace(start.Position)
		if math.abs(localPoint.X) + size.X / 2 + Config.Winners.PlatformMargin <= floor.Size.X / 2
			and math.abs(localPoint.Z) + size.Z / 2 + Config.Winners.PlatformMargin <= floor.Size.Z / 2
			and (start.Position - cameraEnd.Position).Magnitude >= Config.Winners.CameraClearance then break end
		distance = math.max(0, distance - 0.25)
	end
	local start = finish * CFrame.new(0, 0, distance)
	rig:PivotTo(start)
	table.insert(run.Rigs, { Model = rig, Start = start, Finish = finish })
end

function Controller:_effects(run, enabled)
	for _, object in ipairs(run.Effects:GetDescendants()) do
		if object:IsA("ParticleEmitter") then
			object.Enabled = enabled and Config.Effects.ConfettiEnabled and object.Rate > 0
			if enabled and Config.Effects.ConfettiEnabled and object.Rate == 0 then object:Emit(object:GetAttribute("EmitCount") or Config.Effects.BurstCount) end
		elseif enabled and object:IsA("Sound") and Config.Effects.SoundsEnabled and not Config.Effects.DisabledSounds[object.Name] and object.SoundId ~= "" then
			object:Play(); table.insert(run.Sounds, object)
		end
	end
end

function Controller:_travel(run, from, target)
	local alpha = make("NumberValue", { Value = 0 }, run.Container)
	local bounce = false
	table.insert(run.Connections, alpha.Changed:Connect(function(value)
		if not self:_alive(run) then return end
		local frame
		if bounce then
			frame = target * CFrame.new(0, 0, -math.sin(value * math.pi) * Config.Camera.ArrivalBounceStrength)
		else
			frame = from:Lerp(target, value)
			if Config.Camera.HorizontalRotationEnabled then frame *= CFrame.Angles(0, math.rad(Config.Camera.HorizontalRotationDegrees) * math.sin(value * math.pi), 0) end
		end
		run.Camera.CFrame = frame
	end))
	if not self:_tween(run, alpha, Config.Camera.TravelDuration, { Value = 1 }) then return end
	if Config.Camera.ArrivalBounceEnabled then
		bounce = true; alpha.Value = 0
		if not self:_tween(run, alpha, Config.Camera.ArrivalBounceDuration, { Value = 1 }) then return end
	end
	run.Camera.CFrame = target
	run.CameraDone = true
	self:_effects(run, false)
end

function Controller:_walk(run, entry, index)
	task.wait(Config.Winners.WalkStartDelay + (index - 1) * Config.Winners.EntryStagger)
	if not self:_alive(run) then return end
	local track
	if Config.Winners.WalkAnimationId ~= "" then
		local ok, result = pcall(function()
			local animator = entry.Model:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid"):FindFirstChildOfClass("Animator")
			local animation = make("Animation", { AnimationId = Config.Winners.WalkAnimationId }, run.Container)
			return animator:LoadAnimation(animation)
		end)
		if ok then track = result; table.insert(run.Tracks, track); track:Play() else warn("[EndCinematic] Animation unavailable: " .. tostring(result)) end
	end
	local alpha = make("NumberValue", { Value = 0 }, run.Container)
	table.insert(run.Connections, alpha.Changed:Connect(function(v)
		if self:_alive(run) then entry.Model:PivotTo(entry.Start:Lerp(entry.Finish, v)) end
	end))
	self:_tween(run, alpha, Config.Winners.WalkDuration, { Value = 1 })
	if track then track:Stop(0.15) end
	if self:_alive(run) then entry.Model:PivotTo(entry.Finish); run.WalksDone += 1 end
end

function Controller:_hud(run, data, winners)
	local gui = make("ScreenGui", { Name = "EndCinematicHUD", ResetOnSpawn = false, IgnoreGuiInset = true, DisplayOrder = 9990 }, Players.LocalPlayer.PlayerGui)
	table.insert(run.Resources, gui)
	local panel = make("CanvasGroup", { AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 1), Position = UDim2.fromScale(0.5, 0.96), Size = UDim2.new(0.9, 0, 0, 265), BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(12, 14, 25), BackgroundTransparency = 0.08, GroupTransparency = 1 }, gui)
	make("UISizeConstraint", { MaxSize = Vector2.new(700, 265) }, panel)
	make("UICorner", { CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 18) }, panel)
	make("UIStroke", { Color = Color3.fromRGB(255, 199, 62), Thickness = 2 }, panel)
	local won = data.LocalTeam == data.WinningTeam
	local function label(text, y, height, size, color)
		return make("TextLabel", { BackgroundTransparency = 1, Position = UDim2.new(0.04, 0, 0, y), Size = UDim2.new(0.92, 0, 0, height), Text = text, TextColor3 = color or Color3.new(1, 1, 1), Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold, TextSize = size, TextWrapped = true }, panel)
	end
	label(won and "VICTORIA" or "DERROTA", 12, 46, 36, won and Color3.fromRGB(255, 207, 74) or Color3.fromRGB(255, 104, 115))
	label(won and "GANASTE EL DUELO" or "PERDISTE EL DUELO", 58, 25, 16)
	local names = {}; for _, winner in ipairs(winners) do table.insert(names, winner.DisplayName) end
	label("EQUIPO " .. data.WinningTeam .. "  ·  " .. table.concat(names, ", "), 90, 42, 17)
	label(string.format("%d  —  %d", data.Score.Red, data.Score.Blue), 134, 32, 25)
	local back = make("TextButton", { Text = "VOLVER AL LOBBY", Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold, TextSize = 15, TextColor3 = Color3.new(0, 0, 0), BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 207, 74), Position = UDim2.fromScale(0.05, 0.7), Size = UDim2.fromScale(0.43, 0.18) }, panel)
	make("UICorner", { CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 8) }, back)
	local eligible = data.EligibleParticipantCount or (#winners * 2)
	local rematch = make("TextButton", { Text = string.format("REVANCHA (0/%d)", eligible), Active = false, AutoButtonColor = false, Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold, TextSize = 15, TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(140, 145, 160), BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(35, 38, 52), Position = UDim2.fromScale(0.52, 0.7), Size = UDim2.fromScale(0.43, 0.18) }, panel)
	make("UICorner", { CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 8) }, rematch)
	label("REVANCHA · PRÓXIMAMENTE", 238, 18, 11)
	table.insert(run.Connections, back.Activated:Connect(function() self:Stop() end))
	table.insert(run.Connections, gui.Destroying:Connect(function() if self:_alive(run) then self:Stop() end end))
	self:_tween(run, panel, Config.HUD.FadeDuration, { GroupTransparency = 0 })
end

function Controller:Play(data)
	self:Initialize()
	if not RunService:IsStudio() then return false, "PreviewOnly" end
	if Players.LocalPlayer:GetAttribute("MatchId") ~= nil then return false, "MatchActive" end
	if self:IsPlaying() then return false, "AlreadyPlaying" end
	local stage = workspace:FindFirstChild("EndCinematic")
	if not stage then return false, "EndCinematicMissing" end
	if type(data) ~= "table" or type(data.Winners) ~= "table" or #data.Winners < 1 or #data.Winners > Config.Winners.MaxVisible then return false, "InvalidWinners" end
	if type(data.MatchId) ~= "string" or (data.WinningTeam ~= "Red" and data.WinningTeam ~= "Blue") or type(data.Score) ~= "table" or type(data.Score.Red) ~= "number" or type(data.Score.Blue) ~= "number" then return false, "InvalidPayload" end
	local winners = table.clone(data.Winners)
	for _, w in ipairs(winners) do if type(w) ~= "table" or type(w.UserId) ~= "number" or w.UserId == 0 or type(w.DisplayName) ~= "string" or type(w.Slot) ~= "number" then return false, "InvalidWinner" end end
	table.sort(winners, function(a, b) return a.Slot == b.Slot and a.UserId < b.UserId or a.Slot < b.Slot end)
	local cameras, slots = stage:FindFirstChild("TransCamera"), stage:FindFirstChild("Players")
	local from, target = cameras and cameras:FindFirstChild("CameraCheck-v1"), cameras and cameras:FindFirstChild("CameraCheck-v2")
	if not from or not target or not from:IsA("BasePart") or not target:IsA("BasePart") then return false, "CameraReferencesMissing" end
	for index = 1, #winners do local slot = slots and slots:FindFirstChild("SlotPlayer_" .. index); if not slot or not slot:IsA("BasePart") then return false, "InsufficientSlots" end end
	local camera = workspace.CurrentCamera
	if not camera then return false, "CameraMissing" end
	self._serial += 1
	local run = { Id = self._serial, Resources = {}, Tweens = {}, Connections = {}, Tracks = {}, Sounds = {}, Rigs = {}, WalksDone = 0, Camera = camera, CameraType = camera.CameraType, CameraSubject = camera.CameraSubject, CameraCFrame = camera.CFrame, FieldOfView = camera.FieldOfView }
	self._run = run
	run.HiddenHUDs = {}
	for _, gui in ipairs(Players.LocalPlayer.PlayerGui:GetChildren()) do
		if gui:IsA("ScreenGui") and gui.Name ~= "EndCinematicPreview" then
			run.HiddenHUDs[gui] = gui.Enabled
			gui.Enabled = false
		end
	end
	run.Container = make("Folder", { Name = "EndCinematicLocal_" .. run.Id }, workspace)
	table.insert(run.Resources, run.Container)
	local function stop() if self:_alive(run) then self:Stop() end end
	table.insert(run.Connections, workspace:GetPropertyChangedSignal("CurrentCamera"):Connect(stop))
	table.insert(run.Connections, Players.LocalPlayer.CharacterAdded:Connect(stop))
	table.insert(run.Connections, Players.LocalPlayer:GetAttributeChangedSignal("MatchId"):Connect(function() if Players.LocalPlayer:GetAttribute("MatchId") then stop() end end))
	task.spawn(function()
		local ok, err = xpcall(function()
			local panels = self:_transition(run)
			if not self:_slide(run, panels, true) then return end
			camera.CameraType = Enum.CameraType.Scriptable; camera.CFrame = from.CFrame
			for index, winner in ipairs(winners) do
				if not self:_alive(run) then return end
				self:_rig(run, winner, slots["SlotPlayer_" .. index], stage, target.CFrame)
			end
			if not self:_alive(run) then return end
			local original = stage:FindFirstChild("Confeti")
			run.Effects = original and original:Clone() or make("Folder", {}, nil)
			for _, object in ipairs(run.Effects:GetDescendants()) do
				if object:IsA("LuaSourceContainer") then object:Destroy()
				elseif object:IsA("ParticleEmitter") then object.Enabled = false; object:Clear()
				elseif object:IsA("Sound") then object:Stop()
				elseif object:IsA("BasePart") then object.Anchored = true; object.CanCollide = false; object.CanTouch = false; object.Transparency = 1 end
			end
			run.Effects.Parent = run.Container
			task.wait(Config.Transition.ClosedHoldDuration)
			if not self:_alive(run) then return end
			self:_effects(run, true)
			local function guarded(callback)
				task.spawn(function()
					local success, failure = xpcall(callback, debug.traceback)
					if not success then warn("[EndCinematic] " .. tostring(failure)); stop() end
				end)
			end
			guarded(function() self:_travel(run, from.CFrame, target.CFrame) end)
			for index, entry in ipairs(run.Rigs) do guarded(function() self:_walk(run, entry, index) end) end
			if not self:_slide(run, panels, false) then return end
			while self:_alive(run) and (not run.CameraDone or run.WalksDone < #run.Rigs) do task.wait() end
			task.wait(Config.HUD.ShowDelay)
			if self:_alive(run) then self:_hud(run, data, winners) end
		end, debug.traceback)
		if not ok then warn("[EndCinematic] " .. tostring(err)); stop() end
	end)
	return true
end

return Controller
